fields.summary_ko.0: Micron (NASDAQ:MU) rose 6.5% on Thursday after five consecutive trading days of declines, with Lynx Equity analyst driving the stock rebound by arguing that DRAM and NAND memory supply shortages continue.
fields.summary_ko.1: MU stock trades at $750, with analysts setting a one-year target of $1,325, evaluated as 'cheap' with long-term growth rate of 43% or above and PER below 10x.
